issue.title: sonic-db-cli is broken on latest master

failure.body:
**Description**

```
admin@arc-switch1025:~$ sonic-db-cli CONFIG_DB KEYS \*
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/sonic-db-cli", line 131, in <module>
    main()
  File "/usr/local/bin/sonic-db-cli", line 114, in main
    execute_cmd(args.db_or_op, args.cmd, args.namespace, args.unixsocket)
  File "/usr/local/bin/sonic-db-cli", line 82, in execute_cmd
    print("\n".join(resp))
TypeError: sequence item 0: expected str instance, bytes found
admin@arc-switch1025:~$ sonic-db-cli CONFIG_DB HGET "PORT|Ethernet0" lanes
b'0,1,2,3'
admin@arc-switch1025:~$

```

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1.
2.
3.

**Describe the results you received:**
traceback when executing keys command. If executing hget command the output is with prefix b'' which most SONiC scripts won't expect.

**Describe the results you expected:**
keys command works without traceback. If executing get/hget the output is a pure string, without prefix b''.

**Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):**

This probably happened because sonic-db-cli is now using python3 from buster. python3 changed strings from bytes to unicode. Probably that is the issue.

resolution.title: [sonic-py-swsssdk] Advance submodule
resolution.description:
Signed-off-by: Rajendra Dendukuri <<EMAIL>>

**- Why I did it**
Advance sonic-py-swsssdk submodule to fix #4632

**- How I did it**
In py3, the response from redis connector is encoded as byte array. They
need to be decoded before accessing them as strings.

Use following commands to test

sonic-db-cli CONFIG_DB "keys *"
sonic-db-cli CONFIG_DB "hget PORT|Ethernet0 admin_status"

**- How to verify it**

sonic-db-cli CONFIG_DB "keys *"
sonic-db-cli CONFIG_DB "hget PORT|Ethernet0 admin_status"

**- Description for the changelog**

sonic-db-cli: Decode byte encoded response from redis before printing

**- A picture of a cute animal (not mandatory but encouraged)**
